findings.title: Resolve two printed glyph identities in the 工 source passage
findings.details: The source passage supporting the article’s claim that an end-frame contracted into a horizontal stroke contains two unresolved printed forms, currently represented as [glyph:g041] and [glyph:g042]. The source-resolution result says this uncertainty materially affects formation.text and history[0].text; no independent evidence in the dossier verifies those identities. Preserve the forms as unresolved and do not infer replacements.
